_comment: Expressions painted onto a copy of the mob's own texture at runtime (so resource packs are respected). Coordinates are texels inside the front face of the head (box UV origin 0,0: the face starts at 8,8 on a 64px texture), scaled for HD textures. 'erase' pixels take the colour of the texel above them, or of [x, y, source x, source y]; 'ink' pixels take the colour of 'ink_sample' when given (darkened when it is close to the skin under the eyes, the first erase entry's source, as in Fresh Animations' brow-less textures), else of the eye texel. An expression is either a list of ink pixels or {ink, erase (applied after the eyes are erased), eyes: true to keep the eyes}. 'uv_width' is the texture's UV width (default 64; the polar bear's is 128), 'layers': false keeps the expression off overlay layers; 'glow' names the texture of the mob's eyes layer (glowing eyes drawn over the face, the spider's), which gets the expression too: erased texels turn transparent and the ink is that texture's own colour at 'ink_sample'. 'types' maps entity ids to a spec; everything else is 'humanoid'. 'baby_types' does the same for babies, whose models and textures have faces of their own (everything else falls back to 'types').

piglin._comment: 10 texels wide; one white eye texel each side; the snout covers the lower middle, so no mouth

zombified_piglin._comment: half skull (a 2x2 socket on its right), half flesh (one pale eye texel on its left)

villager._comment: villager-style head, 8x10 (zombie villager, villager, wandering trader, witch, illagers); eyes on row 6 under a dark brow, which is also the ink; surprised raises the brow a row (rows 3-5 shifted up, eyes kept), since 2x2 ink under a brow reads as a frown

cow._comment: cow and mooshroom: 8x8 face on the 8x8x6 head box (front face at 6,6), eyes at the edges of row 3

pig._comment: pig: same face as the cow on the 8x8x8 head box (front face at 8,8)

sheep._comment: sheep: 6x6 face (6x6x8 head box, front at 8,8), eyes on row 2; the wool layers sit behind the face and get no expression

goat._comment: goat: the eyes are on the sides of the snout box (east face 34,56 and west face 49,56), black over a white texel; absolute texture coordinates

panda._comment: panda: 13x10 face (13x10x9 head box, front at 9,15); each eye is a white texel and a dark pupil on a black patch, so the ink is the white

polar_bear._comment: polar bear: 7x7 face (7x7x7 head box, front at 7,7) on a 128-wide texture, one dark eye texel each side on row 3

spider._comment: spider and cave spider (Fresh Animations' textures too): 8x8 face on the 8x8x8 head box (front face at 40,12 on the 64x32 texture), eight eyes (16 red texels, rows 0-4) over the fangs; every eye is erased onto a neighbouring skin texel and the expression is inked in the main eyes' red. The eyes layer (spider_eyes.png) glows over it with the same expression

creeper._comment: creeper: 8x8 face on the 8x8x8 head box (front at 8,8 on the 64x32 texture), 2x2 eyes at (1..2, 2..3) and (5..6, 2..3) over the sad mouth; the eyes' lower rows take the skin beside them. Fresh Animations paints only a green socket there and draws the eyes as parts (hidden while an expression shows)

humanoid_baby._comment: baby zombie, husk and drowned: 6x6 face on the 6x6x6 head box (front at 9,9); 2x1 eyes on row 3 at the edges

villager_baby._comment: baby villager and baby zombie villager: 8x8 face on the 8x8x7 head box (front at 7,7); eyes on row 5 under the brow on row 4, which is also the ink; surprised raises the brow a row

piglin_baby._comment: baby piglin: 9x6 face on the 9x6x7 head box (front at 7,7); one white eye texel each side on row 2; the snout covers the lower middle; ink = a nostril (snout front at 22,31)

zombified_piglin_baby._comment: baby zombified piglin: half skull (a 2x2 socket at 2..3, rows 2..3), half flesh (one white eye texel at 6,2)

cow_baby._comment: baby cow and mooshroom: 6x6 face on the 6x6x5 head box (front at 5,23); one black eye texel at each edge of row 2 under a light texel

pig_baby._comment: baby pig: 7x6 face on the 7x6x6 head box (front at 6,21 on its 32x32 texture); black eye texels at 1,2 and 5,2

sheep_baby._comment: baby sheep: 5x5 face on the 5x5x5 head box (front at 5,5 on the 64x32 texture); black eye texels at the edges of row 2; the wool layer gets no expression

goat_baby._comment: baby goat: the eyes are on the sides of the head box (left side at 0,6 and right side at 10,6); absolute texture coordinates

panda_baby._comment: baby panda: 7x6 face on the 7x6x5 head box (front at 5,5); each eye a white texel (1,3 and 5,3) on a black patch, so the ink is the white

polar_bear_baby._comment: baby polar bear: 6x5 face on the 6x5x4 head box (front at 4,4); dark eye texels at 1,2 and 4,2

enderman._comment: enderman: 8x8 face on the 8x8x8 head box (front at 8,8 on the 64x32 texture; its two bottom rows are see-through and the smaller jaw box shows there), 3x1 white eyes on row 4 at x 0..2 and 5..7, each erased onto the dark skin above it; ink = the eye texel. The eyes layer (enderman_eyes.png) glows purple over it with the same expression, inked in its middle texel's colour. Fresh Animations draws its eyes as parts (hidden while an expression shows)

wolf._comment: wolf (all variants, tame and angry too): 6x6 face on the real_head box (front at 4,4 on the 64x32 texture), eyes on row 2: a white texel and a pupil at (0..1, 2) and (4..5, 2), erased onto the fur above; ink = the pupil

wolf_baby._comment: baby wolf: 6x5 face (front at 5,17 on the 32x32 texture), one-texel eyes at (1,2) and (4,2)

fox._comment: fox (red and snow): 8x6 face (front at 7,11 on the 48x32 texture), eyes on row 3: a white texel and a pupil at (0..1, 3) and (6..7, 3); the sleeping texture's closed eyes never show one (a hit wakes it up)

fox_baby._comment: baby fox: 6x5 face (front at 5,5 on the 32x32 texture), one-texel eyes at (1,2) and (4,2)

cat._comment: cats (every variant) and the ocelot: 5x4 face (front at 5,5 on the 64x32 texture), 2-texel eyes on row 1 at x 0..1 and 3..4 (their colours vary per variant); ink = the eye's inner texel. Two 3-wide x x overlap in the middle column

cat_baby._comment: kittens and baby ocelots: 5x4 face (front at 4,4 on the 32x32 texture), one-texel eyes at (1,1) and (3,1)

iron_golem._comment: iron golem: 8x10 face on the head box (front at 8,8 on the 128x128 texture), a dark brow on row 4 over 2x2 eyes at (1..2, 5..6) and (5..6, 5..6), each with a red texel; the top row takes the plate above the brow, the bottom row the plate under the eye shading. The crack layers leave the eyes clear
